units.source_text: 女人不堪事态的重负，不久一定会变得筋疲力尽。

en.t: Unable to bear the weight of the situation, the woman would soon surely become completely exhausted.

units.source_text: 干活的能力下降，甚至给建筑物的安全带来威胁。

en.t: Her ability to work would decline, even bringing a threat to the safety of the building.

units.source_text: 对整个村落来说，这可是严重的大问题呀。

en.t: For the whole village, this was a serious and very big problem.

units.source_text: 劳动力算不上，还拖进来个添麻烦的种。

en.t: He could not be counted as labor, and had even dragged in a source of trouble.

units.source_text: 不把他赶快撵走，将来可就无法收拾了。

en.t: If they did not drive him away quickly, the situation would become impossible to deal with later.
